reason: The hypothesis makes specific claims about relative oxidation kinetics, crystallographic alignment, and thermal expansion matching for Al, Si, and Mn oxides on CrFeCoNiX HEAs, but no prior evidence is cited to support any of these premises.
premises: Al or Si oxides grow more slowly than Mn oxides in CrFeCoNiX HEAs above 900 °C
Al or Si oxides have better crystallographic alignment with the substrate than Mn oxides
Al or Si oxides have better thermal expansion match with the substrate than Mn oxides
Slower growth and better lattice/thermal match reduce stress and prevent cracking/spallation
Mn-containing alloy forms a less adherent, spalling oxide scale under these conditions
